variants.label: A
variants.subject: Amazon brands for {{company_name}}
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most Amazon agencies I speak to grow through referrals, which is great until the referrals slow down.

We run outbound for agencies like {{company_name}}: we find brands already selling on Amazon that are stuck on flat sales, write to them in your voice, and put qualified calls on your calendar. You only take the meetings.

Worth a quick look at how it would work for you?

Thanks,
Maya

variants.label: B
variants.subject: more brands, fewer referrals
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick one. If {{company_name}} could add three or four new Amazon brands a month without anyone on your team prospecting, would that be useful right now?

That is what we do for agencies. We build the list, write the emails, handle the replies and hand you booked calls with brands that fit your sweet spot.

Happy to share a couple of examples if it is relevant.

Maya

variants.label: C
variants.subject: {{first_name}}, a short video
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I recorded a two-minute walkthrough of three Amazon brands in your niche that look like a fit for {{company_name}}, and how we would open a conversation with each of them.

No pitch deck, just the list and the angle.

Shall I send it over?

Maya

variants.subject: question about {{company_name}}
variants.body:

We help Amazon agencies build a steady outbound channel so new business does not depend on who happens to refer you this quarter. Everything is done for you, and you pay for meetings that actually happen.

Open to comparing notes for 15 minutes?

Maya
